svg.title: How composite breakers work
svg.desc: A payments composite has two regions, eu-west and us-east, each with three hosts. Pick walks the tree to a closed host. When a host opens, Pick skips it. When two hosts in a region open, the region trips. When both regions are open, the root trips and calls fail fast. When the hosts' backoff elapses they go HalfOpen, the parents recover early, and a probe closes the path.
svg.text: Pick walks the tree, taking one permit per level, to a closed host
A host fails and opens; Pick skips it and uses its siblings
A second host opens: eu-west trips and traffic shifts to us-east
us-east trips too, so payments trips and calls fail fast at the root
Hosts' backoff elapses: parents go HalfOpen early and a probe closes the path
